name: fhir-questionnaire-kit
description: Monorepo for @fhirq/*: render a FHIR R4 Questionnaire, emit a valid QuestionnaireResponse

scripts.api:check: tsc --build packages/core && api-extractor run -c packages/core/api-extractor.json && api-extractor run -c packages/core/api-extractor.view.json && api-extractor run -c packages/core/api-extractor.resume.json
scripts.api:update: tsc --build packages/core && api-extractor run --local -c packages/core/api-extractor.json && api-extractor run --local -c packages/core/api-extractor.view.json && api-extractor run --local -c packages/core/api-extractor.resume.json
